_comment: Xbox 360 title update (TU) guest addresses for the read-only Xenia combat sampler (tools/xenia_combat_sampler.py). Proven from the TU code listing (work/asi/combat02/analysis/tu_all.txt); 'proof' = TU instruction words the sampler checks before it trusts the addresses. PC / retail counterparts for orientation. 2026-11-09, N18.

object.pc: object id dword [obj+0x14] (index into name table [0xdb94d0], 8-byte entries), [obj+0x60] = name pointer (tru+0x1bf0fb)

brain.pc: same offsets (brain 0x5040 B); state machine +0x1254 (IsInState 0x6711f0: [sm+layer*4+8], name [obj+8]); health +0x2c60 / LP +0x2c64 / stamina +0x2c6c
brain.notes: stamina +0x2c6c: TU stores at 0x822d5374 / 0x822daa88, reader 0x822e3748 (same offset as PC; meaning taken from the PC, gefolgert)

lara_chart.retail: machine +0x500 / +0x510 (update 0x8247c980); TU adds 0x10 before these fields

brain_ext._comment: 2026-11-09 TruXenia (tools/truxenia.py). 'proven' false = shown as '?' unless the viewer enables unproven fields (then marked '~').

requested_state0.why: TU 0x822f13a8..0x822f13c0 r8 = [[inst+0x2d0]]+0x2ec (brain), 0x822f1414 lwz [brain+0x125c] and 0x822f1448 lwz [r8+0x18f8] are compared with the same two state objects

requested_state1.why: follows +0x18f8 as on PC; no TU reader of +0x18fc found

targeting.why: retail brain ctor 0x822d7af8 (= PC 0x634020, map verified) builds EnemyTargeting at +0x4e10 (0x822d80f0 addi r3,r31,0x4e10; bl 0x82341f98); the TU brain ctor 0x822d50a0 builds the same (instruction-equal) ctor TU 0x82341868 at +0x4e60 (0x822d5698) - the TU block shifts the brain by 0x50 between +0x2c90 and +0x3780 (retail +0x3780 / +0x3ec0 / +0x4600 / +0x4e10 = TU +0x37d0 / +0x3f10 / +0x4650 / +0x4e60)

target_slot.pc: EnemyTargeting +0x30 slot: +4 mode (-1 none, 0 sense handle +0x28/+0x2c, 1 instance handle +0x20/+0x24, 2 position); instance stamp +0x44 (TruMenu AwTarget)
target_slot.why: EnemyTargeting ctor is instruction-equal; the getter (PC 0x653b60 = retail 0x823436d0, map unverified) not checked in the TU

coordinator_requester.why: 33 uses of displacement 0x2fc4 in retail and 33 in TU; the brain shift starts after +0x2c90; the TU coordinator itself is not mapped (retail map 'contradicted') - slot state shown as '?'

game_tracker.pc: GameTracker 0xe7f088: +0xc player instance, +0x100 scaled frame dt, +0x118 world time scale (ENGINE.md section 4)
game_tracker.why: TU cloth time step 0x822781dc..0x822781f8 (Befund-Exe-Vergleich-0511): gt = 0x82efb458; dt = [gt+0x100]; if (instance == [gt+0xc]) dt /= [gt+0x118]

player_tracker.pc: player tracker [0xfadb58]: +0x504 CombatManager / player, +0x628 health (PC; TU offset not proven), +0x1244 doppelganger flag (TU only, TruDlc2Player)
player_tracker.why: TU condition 1046 predicate 0x8246e400: [[0x829892b0]+0x1244] byte != 0 -> meter [[0x829892b0]+0x508] flags +4 bit 0, else [[0x829892b0]+0x504]+0x1fc bit 21

meter.flag_bits: 1 power active (condition 1046), 4 shadow look (condition 1055, 0x8246e46c), 8 at or above tuning +0x2c, 0x200 ran empty
meter.why: meter tick TU 0x823d7a10 (this = meter object): flags +4 (0x823d7ac8 / 0x823d7adc), lfs +8 / +0xc (0x823d7b1c / 0x823d7b20); field meaning from the TruShadowPower translation (struct Meter)

position.pc: instance +0x20 position (3 floats; ENGINE.md section 2 'Instance fields')
position.why: TU 0x8238d35c..0x8238d39c: gt = 0x82efb458 (lis -0x7d10 / addi -0x4ba8), r11 = [gt+0xc] (player instance), lfs +0x20 / +0x24 / +0x28 and lvx128 of inst+0x20 subtracted from another vector (2026-11-09 stage 1b)

stamp.why: TU 0x82355158: handle {inst +0, stamp +4} valid when [inst+0x44] == stamp (coordinator requester check 0x82355138)

_comment_1b: 2026-11-09 stage 1b (TruXenia extension after the first live session): every section below has TU proof words; 'basis' says whether the meaning comes from TU code, Xbox data or the PC port (ENGINE.md).

lara_record.why: TU machine reset 0x82482808: r11 = [machine+4] (chart), r10 = s16 [chart+0] start index, r9 = [chart+0xc] record pointer array, r10 = [r9 + 4*index], stw r10 -> [machine+0x520]: +0x520 is a RECORD POINTER, its index is its position in [[machine+4]+0xc] (PC: [machine+0x510] / TruRockVein RecordIndex). Record layout (u16 header: +0xc state-id count, +0x18 pointer to the u16 state ids) as tools/chart_state_path.py reads the Xbox chart DTPs (big endian)

lara_health.basis: code; meaning 'health' from the PC (ENGINE.md section 3 player tracker +0x628)
lara_health.why: TU 0x823e8068..0x823e808c: r11 = [0x829892b0] (player tracker), lfs [r11+0x628] -> stfs [r11+0x634]; computed max -> stfs [r11+0x630]

enemy_test.why: TU enemy init 0x822da9ac..0x822da9e0: [inst+0x50] word 0 == 0xdaf00018 and byte +0x18 != 0 -> brain of 0x50a0 bytes is allocated (PC 0x63c1b5..0x63c1d3 the same test)

melee.raw_state_object_why: TU state switch 0x82349600: r11 = sm + idx*0x19c (0x82349688 mulli), data passed = r11+0x10 (0x82349700), state object stored at r11+0x1a8 (0x82349704 stw r30,0x1a8(r11)); the record sits at ((r11+0x1f)&~0xf)+0x50, so the state object is at raw+0x1a8 - aligned data+0x198 is 4 bytes off when the brain is 16-aligned (live 09.11.: always '?(data)')
melee.basis: code (data address, record pointer); +0x198 state object and +0x78 anim refs {u16 type, u16 anim} x3 from ENGINE.md 13.2 / 13.5 (same on all exes)
melee.why: TU MeleeAttack Enter 0x8232fb48: sm = brain+0x1254, slot = [sm + 4*(0x1a0+layer)] = [brain+0x18d4+4*layer], data = (sm + (slot + 2*layer)*0x19c + 0x1f) & ~0xf; record = [[arg]+0] stored at data+0x50; record +0x136 / +0x138 read

coordinator.basis: code (requester and its handle); meaning of the handle open
coordinator.why: TU MeleeAttack Enter 0x8232fce8: r6 = brain+0x2fc4, bl 0x823551b0(requester, target): 0x82355138 checks the handle {[req+4] instance, [req+8] stamp} ([inst+0x44] == stamp) and a field +0x20 of 0x823548b0(inst); then the target's slot manager 0x82354938(target)+0xf78 != 0. TruXenia logs the handle's instance (whom it points at) as raw data

regenerate_death.why: RegenerateDeath Enter TU 0x8235dff8 (vtable 0x8206ea40 slot 7, state object 0x8277a7b8 named RegenerateDeath, tools/xbox_vtable_owner.py): f31 = old LP [brain+0x2c64], LP := 0x822f8c18(health component) (the maximum from the current tune), then 0x822f8dd8(health, old LP) - so during RegenerateDeath the LP field holds the restored MAXIMUM, not damage; the Y finisher sets it to 0

meter_requests.fields: +0 player time scale request, +4 world time scale request (a value <= 0.0 = slot unused, so 0 and -1 are both empty); the HIGHEST slot with a value > 0 wins, player and world separately -> ramp targets
meter_requests.threshold: 0x8207d538 (0.0 in the TU image): 0x823d7558 lfs f11, -0x2ac8(r31); 0x823d7578 fcmpu f13, f11; ble -> skip the slot
meter_requests.basis: code; slot writers from docs Befund-X23-Kraftlauf-0911.md
meter_requests.why: TU 0x823d7d1c: addi r3, meter, 0x40 -> selector 0x823d7520: r5 = list+0x30 (slot 6), loop to slot 0 (r5 -= 8), lfs [r5+0] player / [r5+4] world; targets stfs [0x827754ac] (lis -0x7d89 / addi 0x54ac) and [0x827754cc] (addi 0x54cc)

object_table.basis: code (PC twin 0xdb7400, ENGINE.md section 2 'Object tracker table')
object_table.why: TU 0x8214684c..0x821468f0: r11 = 0x82979280, 0xcc entries of 0x24, u16 +0xe == 2 and u16 +0xc == id -> object pointer [entry+8]

camera.basis: code (manager address); mode / flags offsets from ENGINE.md section 22 (Xbox +0x54 / +0x7c = PC +0x58 / +0x80); position / look-at / FOV of the current camera not proven on the Xbox - shown '?'
camera.pc: manager 0xe804f0, current camera [mgr+0x44], gameplay camera 0xe83860 (focus +0x1cc), FOV camera +0xb0 (vertical radians), camera matrix 0xe804a0, getters 0x5e7850 / 0x5e7870 / 0x5e78a0 / 0x5e78d0
camera.why: TU 0x822a9a6c..0x822a9a90 (= PC flag reader 0x5e5e8e): r3 = 0x82efc780 (lis -0x7d10 / addi -0x3880), vtable slot 0xac (flag-bit-2 test) called on it
